claims: Submitting IRS Form 4868 by April 15 provides an automatic six-month extension to file a federal tax return.
The extension moves the filing deadline to October 15, 2026.
The extension only applies to filing paperwork, not paying taxes.
Taxpayers must estimate and pay any taxes owed by April 15 to avoid penalties and interest.
All taxpayers can use IRS Free File to request an extension for free, regardless of income.
Paying estimated tax due using Direct Pay, a debit/credit card, or digital wallet and selecting 'Extension' as the reason automatically files the extension.
TurboTax can be used to e-file the extension.
H&R Block can be used to e-file the extension.
FreeTaxUSA can be used to e-file the extension.
Mailing a paper Form 4868 postmarked by April 15 files the extension.
Failure to pay by April 15 can result in interest and penalties, even with an extension.
The extension is automatic upon filling out the form.
No explanation is needed for why the extension is needed.
This information is for tax year 2025/2026.
Tax year 2025/2026 is filed by April 15, 2026.
